### Ask for a feasibility request
As of today, the API does not cover all cases properly meaning that it could answer that the request is feasible when it is not.</br>
Please take the following precautions :
-	ONENOWATTEMPTS should be between 3 and 14 days
-	ONEDAY should be on a time period where at least 1 acquisition is planned and maximum 1 day
-	If you want to be sure, you can use the get attempts path (../api/v1/attempts)
